svg.text: One page. Six fields. No roadmap.

g.text: DEPLOYMENT · ONE WOUND, ONE OWNER, ONE DATE
If a field cannot be filled with a name or a number, the deployment is not ready.
01 · THE WOUND
One sentence, in the team’s own words, with a number in it.
“Credit ops re-keys four documents per file. Two hours each, sixty a week,
thirty percent come back wrong.”
02 · THE OWNER AFTER ME
A named person who has said out loud that they will run it.
Not a steering committee. Someone whose own numbers improve, and who will
answer a message on a Saturday.
03 · THE TUESDAY TEST
What runs differently, and for whom.
Stated as a before and an after. If it cannot be stated this way, you are
building a capability, not a change.
04 · AUTHORITY GRANTED
Exactly what I may change without asking again.
Which fields, which forms, which rule, which report, and who has agreed to
close the old path, by name.
05 · THE METRIC
One number. Measured before I start.
Measured before, or it will be argued about after.
06 · KILL DATE
The day this stops unless the metric moved.
Non-negotiable, and the reason a sceptical director can afford to say yes.
